mapper.select: SELECT 'LABOR' AS "costType", COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS "amount" FROM pm_timesheet WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'APPROVED' UNION ALL SELECT cost_type, SUM(amount) FROM pm_cost WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY cost_type

SELECT period AS "period", SUM(labor) AS "labor", SUM(expense) AS "expense" FROM (SELECT YEAR(work_date) * 100 + MONTH(work_date) AS period, cost AS labor, 0 AS expense FROM pm_timesheet WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'APPROVED' UNION ALL SELECT YEAR(cost_date) * 100 + MONTH(cost_date), 0, amount FROM pm_cost WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'APPROVED') t GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT m.id AS "materialId", COALESCE((SELECT mc.unit_cost FROM fin_material_cost mc WHERE mc.material_id = m.id AND mc.unit_cost > 0 ORDER BY mc.period DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT SUM(i.amount - i.tax_amount) / SUM(i.qty) FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE i.material_id = m.id AND d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN'), 0) AS "unitCost" FROM wms_material m WHERE m.id IN #{id}
